besluite.fout: Missing AWS 2017 comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each state their own subject and verb ('die internet is oopgemaak' and 'het dit makliker geword').
besluite.rede: The second clause has its own subject 'dit' and verb 'het geword', so the comma before 'en' is required and nothing else changes.

besluite.fout: 'van waar jy ook al is' copies English 'from wherever you are' and reads stiffly.
besluite.rede: 'waar jy ook al is' is the natural Afrikaans expression and keeps the same meaning (you can search no matter where you are), one word shorter.
